gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-m-plus-code-latin: M PLUS Code Latin reads like neon tubing bent into letters, constant in thickness, with a wide pitcher mouth on every c. Cherry Swash stands over it, loud and horseshoe-open.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Cherry Swash pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle. M PLUS Rounded 1c, a sans with terminals that stop short of curling back, sets a gentler pace beneath, so body text can stay modest in size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-mandali: Cherry Swash draws every stroke with no thick-and-thin modulation at all, and its diagonals carry as much weight as its verticals. Mandali, a plain sans, follows with a generous entry into the e's eye, so it can sit at modest sizes.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-manjari: Manjari brings curves with wide, unclosed terminals. Underneath that sits a plain sans line of unvarying weight, which Cherry Swash, the commanding display heading above, never tries to match, and a long stretch of text simply flows.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-meera-inimai: Meera Inimai has open-ended curves with room to breathe, and a blueprint-lettering feel from its constant line, which makes a sans body feel approachable. Cherry Swash grabs the eye first, then hands over.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-metrophobic: Metrophobic reads smooth and modern, sending the eye along an unobstructed path around each bend of its sans letters. Cherry Swash, with its neatly bent pipe-cleaner texture, can be the one to go big.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-mina: Cherry Swash opens with a horseshoe-wide c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, which gives the heading a commanding, distinctive look. Mina, a plain sans, keeps its strokes as simple as stitched thread outline, so a longer passage moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-mingzat: Cherry Swash cuts its strokes like a fixed-width router bit, commanding and distinctive, with a horseshoe c leading the way. Mingzat's curvy, unclamped letters are the real draw here.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-moderustic: Moderustic reads modern, its curves traced with a broad nib and left unfinished, which feels loose and contemporary. Cherry Swash, a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts, gives the pair its strongest quality: sharp, distinctive contrast.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-molengo: Approachable and a touch quiet, Molengo is the sans here, with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. Molengo against Cherry Swash, whose line glides under the eye like wire, makes a contrast that is distinctive and easy to spot.
